posts.title: New keyboard
posts.description: One of the two new keyboards I ordered arrived yesterday. This one was meant for the iPad and the writing I do first thing in the morning. It’s a NuPhy Air75, with RGB lights that pulse or cycle through various animations, and power indicators that also do a little dance with light. posts.title: Somewhere in Notes
posts.description: I need a better writing system, but I don’t want to fall into the trap of spending a ton of time looking for that system, or setting it up. A local writer posted on Bluesky recently, showcasing a couple of different software packages for writing. She’s a Scrivener user. I realized from that post that my tools for writing are not much different from a typewriter. Just an iPad screen and a keyboard.

posts.title: Do you have a scar?
posts.description: There’s a crease along my abdomen, or more accurately a fold, that keeps growing as I fuel my days with cookies and popcorn and leave the treadmill as an idea. My chair has a definite dent in it, and most chairs have become increasingly uncomfortable because my ass keeps getting flatter, which seems like a contradiction.
